config.label: A token from UseHourly > Account > AI assistants (read-only or read and change, with an expiry)
config.description: A token from UseHourly > Account > AI assistants (read-only or read and change, with an expiry). The bridge sends it to https://usehourly.app/api/mcp as a Bearer token.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. MCP clients that support OAuth (Claude, Cursor, Smithery) connect with log in and approve and need no header. For a client that cannot, use Bearer <personal access token> from Account > AI assistants at usehourly.app.
